current_finding: Canonical SWAP5 remains without an admitted solute owner or salinity response. This work branch adds independently testable local prototypes for conservative mobile salt mass with explicit upwind advection, the Maas-Hoffman response, and a continuity-based reconstruction of interval-mean internal water face fluxes from accepted start/end storage and signed node sources. The reconstruction is manufactured-tested and checked against a real single-solve Reference Richards case with nonzero subsurface source and separately bound nonzero root sink. The broader live serialized FMR A8 transaction suite now passes at O0/O2 after fixture-local matrix_area_fraction repair; its A7 case accepts nonzero qrot with closed transactional water mass and passes discard/replay/restart. This does not bind reconstructed face fluxes to FMR: current boundary observations are from the last internal solver step rather than the accepted candidate interval aggregate. Salt state remains unbound to transaction/restart and omits dispersion/substeps. Jarvis remains fail-closed for salinity. Added a falsifiable transport boundary: an interval-mean continuity flux cannot identify gross or ordered advective transport under within-interval reversal, so it remains diagnostic-only. The physics test now includes an executable reversal counterexample showing equal/opposite half-step water fluxes yield zero signed mean but nonzero ordered donor-concentration salt transfer. Checked the official SWAP release path: it advertises SWAP 4.3.1 development release but exposes a registration form, not an accessible source archive in this execution. Exact B1.11 solute source remains unavailable here. Exact B0/B1.11 member identity for SWAP/solute.f90 is known from the local manifest (SHA-256 2fc8592001cdcd2de95a252d8b9099416c94e4d2654c335908858a735f80e7a2; 51,508 bytes); B1.11 SWAP-011 does not modify that member. The raw bytes remain unavailable for semantic reconstruction.
historical_reconstruction: Source-family evidence distinguishes Maas-Hoffman switch 1 as a nodewise alpha(CML) from osmotic-head switch 2, which modifies matric-flux potential and requires Jong-van-Lier drought; switch 2 is not a separate multiplicative alpha_sol. Source-family census additionally establishes SWINCO-dependent initial versus warm-restart concentration profiles, CMSY inventory derived from water content/CML and optional Freundlich sorption, explicit boundary and drainage fluxes, internal solute substeps, and root salt uptake TSCF*qrot*CML. Exact B1.11 solute-member and restart details remain unverified in this execution.

Canonical runtime/restart has no salt-state owner; the current module is a pure trial transformation and is not an accepted production transaction.

FMR represents optional physical continuations through explicit clone families and template-layout cases. A salinity state must define coexistence with these families and preserve salinity-disabled layouts before changing production state interfaces.

Prototype is explicit advective upwind only, with no dispersive flux, internal timestep substeps, drainage, boundary schedule, or restart serialization. These remain separate physical/numerical acceptance gates.

The A8 FMR boundary observation currently reports the last internal Richards solver-step flux, not an aggregate across the accepted FMR candidate interval. A live FMR salt-transport trace therefore needs accepted-substep water and boundary-flux evidence plus complete route-specific source/sink accounting.

An interval-mean flux reconstructed from endpoint storage and net sources is not an admissible salt-advection input when flow direction can change inside the interval; the trace must preserve accepted substep order and discard with rejected candidates.

Exact raw SWAP/solute.f90 bytes (manifest SHA-256 2fc8592001cdcd2de95a252d8b9099416c94e4d2654c335908858a735f80e7a2; 51,508 bytes) are not materialized. B1.11 leaves this B0 member unchanged, but the manifest hash alone cannot establish detailed source semantics. Public SWAP-model/SWAP source remains an older corroborative family.
recovery_point: PPA-WU05-E has restricted E1 and E2 local prototypes on the work branch. Focused O0/O2 salinity tests pass, including a manufactured and restricted real-Reference-Richards conservative internal water-face-flux reconstruction. The direct solve includes nonzero qssdi and separately bound nonzero qrot. The A8 O0/O2 FMR transaction/restart suite now passes with nonzero qrot, after correcting incomplete test-only matrix_area_fraction configuration. However the FMR observation does not expose interval-aggregated boundary fluxes or accepted-substep traces, so continuity reconstruction is not connected to FMR and live solute transport is not qualified. A source-backed transaction/restart audit establishes that kernel commit and Restart v2 each own one physical state object and that FMR restart layout is explicitly discriminated. The branch has selected an optional typed salt component plus an independent template/restart layout identity; this design is proposed, not canonically accepted or implemented. No Jarvis interface was changed and no salinity capability is qualified/admitted. Exact B1.11 solute-member bytes, common-state/clone/restart implementation, and live accepted-substep transport binding remain open.

source_family_census.initialization: SWINCO != 3 interpolates ZC/CML input to nodes; SWINCO = 3 consumes a warm-start concentration profile and does not reapply the initial table (source-family only).
source_family_census.state: CML is mobile-water concentration; CMSY is dissolved plus adsorbed mass per bulk soil volume; column inventory integrates CMSY over node thickness.
source_family_census.transport: Surface input, inter-node advective/dispersive flux, bottom exchange, lateral drainage, root uptake, optional decomposition; internal solute substeps.
source_family_census.root_salt_uptake: TSCF*qrot*CML is a solute-mass sink; must use the same candidate/accepted qrot as the one root-water sink.
source_family_census.ownership: Dedicated solute-state owner advances candidate salt mass and commits/rolls it back with the physical transaction; Jarvis reads concentration only.
source_family_census.exact_source_limit: All equations and lifecycle details above are source-family corroboration only, not byte-exact B1.11 claims.

initial_e1_envelope: One conservative dissolved salt constituent in mobile water; SWSP=0; decomposition, macropore, ageing, aquifer mixing, MICRO and lateral drainage off; explicit top/bottom solute boundary traces; root salt uptake through TSCF*qrot*CML with restricted 0<=TSCF<=1; node salt mass authoritative, CML derived from matching committed/trial water content; paired water/salt trial commit/discard.
